source_metadata.name: King James Version
source_metadata.qualification: These labels are upstream provenance metadata, not an independent bibliographical certification by ml-didacticism.

verification.upstream_reference: Bible SuperSearch KJV module 6.2.0, identified by that provider as Authorized King James Version, 1611 / 1769
verification.fingerprint_algorithm: SHA-512 over the domain bytes followed, in canonical biblical order, by 4-byte big-endian UTF-8 filename length, filename bytes, 8-byte big-endian file length, and exact raw file bytes for each of the 66 book JSON files.

invariants: KJV is not a sufficient source identifier.
A verse ID is an address, not evidence.
The immutable git snapshot plus byte fingerprints identify the evidence substrate.
Downstream revisions must not mutate upstream evidence.
